data.name: Title
data.value: Certificate of registration – review and send

data.name: StepUp_Ok
data.value: You are now signed in with the trust level “{0}”. Check your details and send the application.

data.name: Level_Ok
data.value: You are signed in with “{0}” – that is sufficient. The application is received directly when you send it.

data.name: Level_StepUp
data.value: For a certificate of registration the citizens' office requires the highest trust level “{0}”; you are signed in with “{1}”. When you send it, the portal briefly takes you to BundID – sign in there with your online ID card (in the simulator: “EID (Ausweis)”). Afterwards you come back to this page and send the application.

data.name: Level_Technical_Text
data.value: The portal starts a new OpenID Connect request with acr_values=STORK-QAA-Level-4. The auth server turns it into a SAML AuthnRequest with RequestedAuthnContext “high” (comparison minimum); BundID then only offers identification methods with a high level (online ID card, eIDAS, FINK). The signed response contains the level reached, and the API checks it again when the application is submitted (policy “high”).

data.name: Next1
data.value: You immediately receive an acknowledgement in your BundID mailbox.

data.name: Next2
data.value: The (simulated) processing takes a few minutes; each step arrives as a status message in your mailbox.

data.name: Next3
data.value: Afterwards the certificate is in your mailbox and ready to print in the portal.
